howItWorks.subtitle: We keep billing transparent and logistics dependable so your mornings stay uninterrupted.

farm.title: Where your milk comes from and how it is handled.
farm.lead: Most urban market milk passes through intermediaries who chill, pool, re-pasteurise, and adulterate it with starch or water. Our milk never leaves our closed chain.

facts.title: Dietary fodder grown on clean soil
facts.detail: Animals feed on certified seasonal green silage (maize, berseem, sorghum), natural hay, and oilseed cakes. Zero antibiotic feed supplements.

facts.title: Morning & evening milking routines
facts.detail: Milking takes place twice a day using automated Swedish stainless steel milking clusters that prevent hand contamination.

facts.title: Chilled down to 4°C within 45 minutes
facts.detail: Milk enters our bulk milk cooler (BMC) immediately to stop bacterial development cold, without needing boiling or chemical preservatives.

facts.title: Food-grade sanitised glass bottles
facts.detail: Bottled in sterile reusable glass containers. Glass leaves zero microplastics, keeps milk colder, and retains original dairy aroma.

facts.title: Routine purity and fat testing
facts.detail: Every batch is tested on lactometer and ultrasonic milk analyzers for density, fat percentage, and total solids before dispatch.

items.q: Which sectors and areas do you deliver to?
items.a: We currently deliver daily morning orders across PWD Society, DHA Phases 1 & 2, Bahria Town (Phases 1-8), Pakistan Town, Media Town, Soan Gardens, and CDA sectors including F-6, F-7, F-8, F-10, F-11, G-9, G-10, G-11, and I-8. If your area is nearby, message us on WhatsApp to confirm delivery route feasibility.

items.q: What time does the delivery arrive?
items.a: Our cold delivery vans run every morning between 5:30 AM and 7:00 AM. Your milk arrives before breakfast so your morning tea and breakfast routine are ready without delay.

items.q: How does the monthly billing and payment work?
items.a: There is no upfront charge or card required. On the 1st of each calendar month, our dispatch system tallies your exact deliveries and sends an itemised PDF statement via WhatsApp. You can clear it within 5 days using direct bank transfer, Raast ID, JazzCash, or EasyPaisa.

items.q: What happens when I go on vacation or need to pause?
items.a: You can pause, resume, or change delivery quantities anytime. Just send a brief message to our WhatsApp support number before 8:00 PM the previous evening. You are only billed for days your bottles were delivered.

items.q: Why do you use glass bottles instead of plastic pouches?
items.a: Glass is 100% inert, meaning no harmful microplastics, BPA, or phthalates leach into fresh milk. It chills faster, keeps the milk tasting pure, and prevents environmental plastic waste. We collect the rinsed empty bottles during your next delivery.

items.q: Is the milk raw or pasteurised? Do we need to boil it?
items.a: Our milk is chilled immediately to 4°C at the farm and transported in temperature-controlled boxes. We offer raw fresh milk (preferred by traditional customers who prefer their own gentle boil) as well as batch-pasteurised milk. As standard kitchen practice in Pakistan, a gentle boil is recommended before consumption.
